title: Aloo Papri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add potatoes & mash well with the help of masher.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein aloo dal dein aur masher ki madad sa ache tarhan mash ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add all-purpose flour,semolina,red chill crushed,cumin seeds,pink salt,carom seeds,clarified butter & mix well until it crumbles.
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida,sooji,lal mirch crushed,zeera,pink salt,ajwain aur ghee dal dein aur crumble ho janay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Gradually add water,mix well & knead until soft dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker soft dough tayyat ker lein aur dhak ker 15 minutes kiya chor dein.

steps.instruction: -Sprinkle dry flour & knead until dough is smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida chirak dein aur dough ko smooth ho janay tak ache tarhan ghond lein.

steps.instruction: -Divide the dough in small portions,take one portion & make a ball,sprinkle dry flour & roll out into thin sheet with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: -Dough ko small portions mein divide karein,ek portion la ker ball bana lein,maida chirak dein aur rolling pin ki madad sa thin sheet bail lein.

steps.instruction: -Prick with fork & cutout small round shapes with the help of the cutter (1 & 2 inches).
steps.romanUrdu: -Fork ki madad sa prick ker lein aur cutter ki madad sa round shapes cut ker lein (1 & 2 inches).

steps.instruction: -In a wok,heat cooking oil (150°C) & fry on low flame until golden brown & crispy.
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil garam karein (150°C) aur halki ancch per golden brown & crispy ho janya tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: -In a mortal & pestle,add cumin seeds,citric acid,red chilli powder,pink salt,chicken powder & crush until well combined.Papri masala is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: -Mortal & pestle mein zeera,tatri,lal mirch powder,pink salt aur chicken powder dal ker ache tarhan crush ker lein.Papri masala tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: -Sprinkle prepared papri masala on papri & toss well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Tayyar papri masala ko papri per sprinkle ker ka ache tarhan toss ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Can be stored in an airtight jar for up to 1 week (Shelf life).
steps.romanUrdu: -Airtight jar mein dal ker 1 week kliya store ker saktay han (Shelf life).

steps.instruction: -Serve on chana chaat,papri chaat,dahi bhalla & cholay!
steps.romanUrdu: -Chana chaat,papri chaat,dahi bhalla & cholay ka saath serve karein!
